name: What kind of projects does AKN Design Group specialize in with its design-build services?

mainEntity.name: What kind of projects does AKN Design Group specialize in with its design-build services?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in high-value, customized residential transformations, focusing on significant renovations rather than minor repairs. Our expertise includes luxury kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, comprehensive whole-home remodels, substantial home additions like primary suites or home offices, and high-end outdoor living spaces such as custom patios and outdoor kitchens. We guide homeowners from initial design planning, including CAD-supported layouts, through construction, installation, and final walkthrough, ensuring a cohesive and functional outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group specializes in high-value, customized residential renovations, including luxury kitchens, spa bathrooms, whole-home remodels, additions, and high-end outdoor living spaces.
